name: Reward Burst
summary: Reward from the button that earned it: 12-40 particles with mass, drag, rotation and gravity, one tint with brightness variation, gone within ~1 s. .burst haptic first.

accessibility.reduceMotion: no particles, single glow pulse from the button; haptic unchanged

states.motion: 12–40 pieces launch from the button top edge, closed-form drag + gravity, ≤1 s, fade over the last 30%
states.haptic: .burst on the first frame, before any visual work

states.motion: overlay removed when the last piece dies
one glow pulse from the button, scale 1→1.6, opacity 0.5→0 over 400 ms
